title: Dashboard
one_liner: One page that lists every capstone and portfolio service with a live status dot, the stack, an Open link and its brief.

steps.text: The front door: every capstone and portfolio service on one page
The header counts the services up; each dot polls /health every ten seconds
Capstones: three Caltech capstones as five services, each with a port and an Open link
Portfolio: eight apps grouped by target role
Computer vision: the Headstorm blueprint and menu pipelines
Every card has a Brief: the problem, the build, the numbers and the limits
Close it; the page keeps polling
The hint box: just up, just check, just down from the repository root
Back to the top: everything green means every service answered
